correctness.rationale: The killed kernel has similarity factor ρ^(j−i) and rate factor exp(−λt); the geometric factors in the exact initial law cancel in i. The Bessel recurrence tel­escopes into a positive sum with indices |i−j|+1, |i−j|+3, … and index sum ij. Contour tilting with min(|k|/(2z),1) yields the Gaussian-to-exponential bound in the proof, and angular rescaling gives the Gaussian local limit uniformly on compact diffusive windows. With j≤L log z the indices in the recurrence are i+O(log z). For β<2 the small-i part has relative bound of order ε^(2−β) below ε√z, and the large-i tail vanishes beyond R√z as R grows. The weighted Riemann sum has coefficient 2^(−β/2)Γ(1−β/2); at β=2 the main harmonic range up to √z/log z supplies (1/2)log z, with the omitted middle range O(log log z) and decaying outer tail. The log cutoff in j is justified by ρ^j times a polynomial bound from the Poisson jump count even for β<0. This proves the normalized ℓ¹ claim and exact constants, including the use of z=2√(ab)t. The left eigenvector recurrence has the double root ρ at decay rate λ, giving the minimal QSD, and reduces exactly to the initial law at β=−1, with H_−1=1. The comparison regime β>2 follows by domination of i^(1−β)jρ^j. The relative polynomial prefactor can grow for β<−1 without contradicting decay of the survival probability. At β=2 the mass is spread across logarithmic entrance scales, not concentrated at order √t; the discussion's diffusive-scale explanation should be read as applying to β<2.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed finding on survival-conditioned entrance localization uses the identical walk and exact initial law for β>0. It proves the same sharp terminal and survival equivalents (including the log term and its exact coefficient) for the entire range 0<β≤2, with the same ℓ¹ control, in addition to the stronger joint entrance/terminal result. This is verified coverage of the central advertised threshold, not just a possible match. Both records carry the same date; their date does not resolve priority, and this decision makes no attribution about order or derivation. β≤0 is outside the explicit scope of the other result, but the weighted Gaussian argument already works there without a new critical mechanism, and the remaining terminal bound only needs a routine polynomial domination of a Poisson jump count. I do not propose a narrowed repair as a new valuable threshold result.
residual_risks: No chronology, provenance relationship or cross-reference resolving order between the two same-day works was established.
No comprehensive historical priority claim is made, including for the β≤0 extension.
